ValidationRule.description: Retained and Terminated accounts must have value in this field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( IM_At_Risk_Status__c, "Retained"), ISPICKVAL( IM_At_Risk_Status__c, "Terminated"), ISPICKVAL( IM_At_Risk_Status__c, "Salvaged") ), ISBLANK( Retained_Terminated_Date__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a date the account was Retained or Terminated
